# Support

We provide community-driven support for the Pangolin Kubernetes Controller.

## Questions and Help

* 🧵 GitHub Discussions: <https://github.com/orgs/fosrl/discussions>
* 🐞 Issues: use the issue templates in this repository for bug reports and
  feature requests.
* 💬 Slack: join the `#pangolin` channel in the Kubernetes community Slack for
  quick questions.

## Commercial Support

Commercial support is not offered by the maintainers. If you require paid
support, please reach out via [support@pangolin.net](mailto:support@pangolin.net)
and we can connect you with partners familiar with the project.

## Service Level

The project is maintained on a best-effort basis. Response times may vary, but
we aim to acknowledge new GitHub issues within three business days.
